name: agentscope
description: Connects a session to agentscope and holds it to the working rules: bgrun jobs above the prompt, a pane showing the session as agentscope sees it (/agentscope), a load gate for benchmarks, a guard that sends long commands through bgrun, and limits and a handoff line for sessions started by another session.

jobsBand.title: Jobs band
jobsBand.description: Show this session's bgrun jobs above the prompt and say when one ends.

sessionPane.title: Session pane (/agentscope)
sessionPane.description: The /agentscope command and its pane: this session's CPU, memory, JVMs, jobs, PRs and spawned sessions.

loadGate.title: Benchmark load gate
loadGate.description: Refuse perflab and JMH runs while other sessions use more than about one core. LOAD_GATE=off in the command overrides.

bgrunGuard.title: bgrun guard
bgrunGuard.description: Refuse known-long commands (sbt partest, scripted, test suites, mvn verify) that are not wrapped in bgrun. BGRUN=off in the command overrides.

longCommands.title: More long commands
longCommands.description: A regular expression; a command line it matches is also treated as long by the bgrun guard. Empty for none.

spawnedGuard.title: Spawned-session guard
spawnedGuard.description: In a session started by another session: refuse gh PR, issue, comment and review writes and pushes outside your own GitHub owners, and force-pushes to branches the session did not create.

ownOwners.title: Your GitHub owners
ownOwners.description: Owners (users or organizations) a spawned session may write to, separated by commas.

dashboardUrl.title: agentscope page
dashboardUrl.description: Where agentscope's page is served; the pane links to this session's drawer there.

handoffLine.title: Handoff line
handoffLine.description: In a session started by another session: at the end of a turn, append repo, branch, pushed state and PR, taken from git and gh, to ~/.claude/side-sessions/<date>-<branch>.md.
